title: Drift-aware lease fallback and transparent rollforward for reserved-tenant quotas
creator: Ayesha Malik
description:
Problem: Reserved capacity customers occasionally observe transient quota overdrafts around mid-cycle lease handoffs and cross-region failovers. Root causes include clock skew between quota ledger writers, delayed checkpoint propagation, and two-phase lease renewal races when a tenant is migrated or autoscaled. These overdrafts can cause short-term overconsumption billing anomalies and customer confusion

Goal: Implement a drift-aware lease fallback and transparent rollforward mechanism that ensures: (1) no double-counting during lease transitions, (2) a readable audit trail for billing reconciliation, and (3) graceful temporary top-ups that do not create permanent charge discrepancies. The mechanism should work for daily and monthly windows and for rolling-window quotas used by reserved pools.

Scope: Server-side quota ledger + reservation manager changes, migration to an idempotent reset protocol, meter reconciliation job updates, new tracing spans and audit events, and a console-facing incident summary for affected tenants. This ticket focuses on the orchestration, invariant guarantees, and telemetry; low-risk UX changes (console copy) are in a follow-up.

acceptance_criteria: No double-counting: When a lease is handed off between pool managers, aggregated tenant usage during the transition window must equal the single-writer scenario within a 0.01% tolerance on synthetic tests.
Idempotent rollback: Re-applying the same rollforward must not change ledger balances beyond logging-level side effects.
Auditability: Every lease handoff must emit checkpoint snapshots with stable snapshot_hash and tenant-scoped HMAC; snapshots retained for 90 days and queryable by billing team.

Safe fallback: If checkpoint propagation fails, the controller must temporarily serve from a conservative top-up policy (configurable per-tenant) and generate an incident with automatic reconciliation when connectivity recovers.
Integration tests: End-to-end test that simulates cross-region failover, DST edge cases, and month-boundary rollovers must pass in CI with synthetic workloads and assert zero net drift.
Console visibility: Incidents and reconciliations surfaced in Console incidents dashboard with root-cause tags and a downloadable audit log link.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 - Branch and unit tests: Complete idempotent executor and local ledger simulation (done).
Phase 2 - Canary: Deploy to 10% quota writers in us-east-1 with reconciler in read-only mode for 24h, then enable active rollforward if no anomalies (current).
Phase 3 - Regional ramp: Expand to us-west-2 and eu-west-1 over 48h with telemetry thresholds gating further rollout.
Phase 4 - Global switch: Enable default fallback policy for all reserved pools behind feature flag and monitor billing ingest for 7 days before removing flag.
Rollback: Feature-flagged immediate disable; ledger remains consistent due to idempotence. Post-rollback plan includes forensic run of reconciliation job to ensure no partial adjustments.
telemetry_checks: QuotaBalanceDelta: distribution of per-tenant balance deltas pre- and post-handoff (alert if >0.05% of tenants exceed threshold).
LeaseHandoffLatency: p95 handoff latency (goal < 200ms), track tail for cross-region events.
ReconcilerFailures: count and error types; must be zero for critical path errors for >99.9% of handoffs.
AuditSnapshotIntegrity: mismatch rate between snapshot_hash and persisted snapshot (must be zero).
BillingIngestDrift: end-to-end consumer-reported vs collector-reported usage discrepancy aggregated weekly (goal <0.01%).
implementation_notes: Ledger model changes: Add checkpoint record with fields: lease_id, owner_node_id, window_start, window_end, snapshot_hash, hmac, applied_until_token.
Idempotent rollforward executor: Implement using compare-and-apply semantics keyed by snapshot_hash; if applied_until_token matches, noop and emit event 'rollforward.noop'.
Race mitigation: Use short-lived fencing tokens during handoff and conservative pre-handoff snapshot to prevent overlapping writer windows.

Top-up policy: Default conservative top-up equals 10% of remaining daily quota for reserved tenants; configurable via tenant policy. This top-up is reversible and must be zeroed in reconciliation if not used.

Tests: Add deterministic time-travel harness and chaos tests that inject delayed checkpoint writes, slow networks, and DST leaps. Add billing-integration CI job referencing synthetic accounting ledger (job: billing-integration/lease-fallback).

Operational runbook: Document handoff diagnostics, manual reconciliation steps, and how to request audit snapshots for customer disputes. Draft runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Lease+Fallback+Runbook
